'''2019 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Bochum, Germany, 20–22 September 2019. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] defeated [[Bryan Mischke]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 20–22 September 2019
